issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the quantity getter in StockIngredient: the template implementation declares a method named retrieveQuantity() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) while other code and the solution expect a standard getter getQuantity(). The Stock class in the template calls getQuantity() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) causing a compilation error. The problem statement also instructs students to "add getters for all the private fields" (problem_statement.md), which implies the conventional getX naming. This mismatch will prevent successful compilation and confuses students about the expected getter name.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a standard getter named getQuantity() on StockIngredient. Either rename the existing template method retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity(), or add a new public int getQuantity() that returns the stored quantity (it may delegate to retrieveQuantity()). Ensure the signature matches usages in Stock (calls to getQuantity()) so the project compiles and matches the problem statement requirement to "add getters for all the private fields."
